fields.label: Mode
fields.help: uniform: one point per voxel; max_tls: keep every TLS point. Mohammad's calibrated value: max_tls.

fields.label: Surface tolerance (m)
fields.help: Surface tolerance in m. Empty = CLI default (taken from the registration QA). Mohammad's calibrated value: 0.05.

fields.label: Min plane points
fields.help: Minimum points for the reliability plane fit.

fields.label: Q max
fields.help: Plane RMSE / surface radius. Mohammad's calibrated value: 0.20.

fields.label: Products
fields.help: Layered outputs (default) plus optional merged convenience files.

fields.label: Axial max (deg)
fields.help: Reliability: P90 axial normal deviation gate (degrees, sign-safe). Mohammad's calibrated value: 50.0.

fields.label: Keep isolated photo points
fields.help: Keep isolated photo points instead of diverting them to photo_rejected.laz.

fields.label: Confidence field
fields.help: Photo dimension holding confidence (explicit, never assumed). Empty = not passed.

fields.label: Confidence min
fields.help: Minimum confidence value (number). Empty = not passed.

fields.label: Include ambiguous
fields.help: Put AMBIGUOUS points into fused.laz instead of a separate file.
